data.title: Checkout errors increased after a production change
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: A dashboard note suggests a recent traffic increase may be involved.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The recent production change introduced a regression in the payment-service that increases checkout errors and latency, possibly due to a misconfigured dependency or resource contention.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Collect and analyze payment-service logs for error patterns and stack traces during the incident window.', success_signal='Logs show a consistent increase in specific error codes (e.g., 502, 504) and stack traces pointing to the new code path introduced in the latest deployment.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Retrieve and compare payment-service latency metrics (p95) before and after the change, and correlate with traffic volume.', success_signal='p95 latency spikes above 800ms coincide with the deployment timestamp and increased request rate.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Inspect tracing data to identify any downstream calls (e.g., to auth-service, inventory-service) that are timing out or failing.', success_signal='Tracing reveals increased timeout rates on a specific downstream dependency introduced in the new release.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Validate that the suspected dependency is correctly configured (e.g., connection pool size, timeout settings).', success_signal='Configuration review shows misaligned timeout values or insufficient pool size causing failures.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Rollback the recent deployment or apply a hotfix to the payment-service to remove the problematic code path.', success_signal='Rollback or hotfix deployment completes without errors and the service restarts successfully.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='Monitor payment-service metrics and error rates post-rollback to confirm restoration of checkout success >=99% and p95 <=800ms.', success_signal='Metrics return to baseline levels and customer-facing errors cease.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='Implement automated tests or canary checks for the affected dependency to prevent future regressions.', success_signal='Canary tests detect similar latency or error patterns before full rollout.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Document root cause, remediation steps, and preventive controls in the post‑mortem.', success_signal='Post‑mortem is completed, shared with stakeholders, and action items are tracked.', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The incident was triggered after a deployment, and the operator notes a traffic spike. The service objective is breached, and customer-facing errors are active. Objective evidence will come from logs, metrics, and tracing to confirm increased error rates and latency in payment-service, and to rule out unrelated traffic or external dependencies.')
